title: Viva Insights: Agent 365 Dashboard adds reporting for third-party platform agents
summary: Hold: the checklist treats connected platforms as determining dashboard coverage, although the briefing correctly says Microsoft has not documented that dependency. It also excludes administrators from the readership and omits important conditions for leaders' automatic access; the roadmap facts and documented licensing requirements are accurate.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard policy route is Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Access Management > Turn Advanced Insights on or off > Feature access management > Agent Dashboard > Add policy in Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Viva Insights. ... Set up and management tab. ... Under Access Management, select Turn Advanced Insights on or off. On the Feature access management page, select Agent Dashboard and Add policy.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId AgentDashboard -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone sets a tenant-wide disabling policy for the Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Agent Dashboard for all users in your tenant. ModuleId : VivaInsights; FeatureId : AgentDashboard; Name : DisableFeatureForAll; IsFeatureEnabled : false; Everyone

claims.claim: The web app user access route is Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Users > Add in Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Viva Insights. ... Set up and management tab. ... Under Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, select Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard. ... At the top, select Users. ... At the bottom, select Add.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone sets a tenant-wide disabling policy for the whole web app.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant. ModuleId : VivaInsights; FeatureId : Viva Insights web app; Name : DisableFeatureForAll; IsFeatureEnabled : false; Everyone
